name: io.github.WYRE-AI/alga-psa-mcp
title: Alga PSA
description: Read-only Alga PSA MCP server: 42 curated GET tools for tickets, clients, time and billing.

environmentVariables.name: ALGA_INSTANCE_URL
environmentVariables.description: The https:// address you use to sign in to Alga, for example https://psa.example.com. A trailing / or /api/v1 is fine; leave off any other path. Works for Nine Minds–hosted and self-hosted instances. Self-hosted instances must be reachable from the internet over HTTPS with a valid certificate.

environmentVariables.name: ALGA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the Alga user this connection acts as. Create it in Alga under Profile → API Keys. The key gets that user's permissions, so use a dedicated user with a limited role.

environmentVariables.name: ALGA_TENANT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Leave blank unless Alga support asks for it. A wrong value makes every request fail.

environmentVariables.name: ALGA_TOOL_TIERS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool tiers. Every tool is read-only, so the only valid value is read (the default). The X-Conduit-Tool-Tiers request header can only narrow this set.
